He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia Cavaliers]]. ==Early life and high school career== Dunn grew up in [[Freeport, New York]]. He initially attended [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]] as a boarding student, where he played on the school's third basketball team.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbs19news.com/story/48279553/from-out-of-nowhere-ryan-dunn-energizes-virginia|title=From out of nowhere Ryan Dunn energizes Virginia|website=[[WCAV|CBS19New.com]]|date=January 31, 2023|access-date=October 17, 2023}} After his sophomore year he transferred to [[Long Island Lutheran Middle and High School|Long Island Lutheran High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.startribune.com/four-star-ny-guard-ryan-dunn-on-recent-gophers-official-visit-fan-base-in-minnesota-was-really-big/600095922/|title=Four-star NY guard Ryan Dunn on recent Gophers official visit: "fan base in Minnesota was really big"|work=[[Star Tribune]]|date=September 10, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2023}} Dunn averaged nine points and four assists per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/high-school/boys-basketball/top-100-players-long-island-2021-w69660|title=Top 100 boys basketball players on Long Island for 2021|work=[[Newsday]]|date=February 9, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}} After graduating from Long Island Lutheran, he opted to enroll at the [[Perkiomen School]] in [[Pennsburg, Pennsylvania]] for a [[postgraduate year]].{{cite web|url=https://dailyprogress.com/sports/unique-high-school-basketball-journey-helped-prepare-ryan-dunn-to-thrive-at-virginia/article_aca6221e-bddd-11ed-a22a-7f458d9afc78.html|title=Unique high school basketball journey helped prepare Ryan Dunn to thrive at Virginia|first=Greg|last=Madia|work=[[The Daily Progress]]|date=March 8, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2023}} Dunn was rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to playing college basketball for [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] over offers from [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]], [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]], [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]], [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]], and [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/virginia/basketball/uva-mens-basketball-receives-commitment-from-ryan-dunn|title=Four-Star Recruit Ryan Dunn Commits to Virginia|first=Matt|last=Newton|website=[[SI.com]]|date=September 18, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}}{{cite Gophers|work=[[Star Tribune]]|date=September 18, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}} ==College career== Dunn was a key bench player during his freshman year at Virginia.{{cite web|url=https://dailyprogress.com/sports/virginias-overhauled-very-athletic-roster-makes-for-critical-summer/article_87bb7b98-270f-11ee-b571-a3761968aaa3.html|title=Virginia's overhauled, 'very
